Range 30 feet

Targets 1 creature that is fascinated with you or that failed a Will save against one of your effects this encounter

Frequency once per day

Saving Throw Will

Drag a fascinated or cowed creature toward you.

The target must succeed at a Will save against your class DC or, at the start of its next turn, move up to its Speed toward you by the path of its choice as a free action, provoking as normal; on a critical failure it also can't attack you that turn. Desire is a leash, if you know how to hold it.
